json_ld.description:
A do-it-all solution to charge all your devices and complement all interior styles, Rise 3-in-1 Magnetic Wireless Charger brings design and performance center stage. Advanced Qi2 charging, adjustable angles, and a multi-device setup ensure high functionality; while the modern finish and leather-like detail deliver on a statement design piece for any space.

Foldable multi-device charging stand to charge all your tech at once

 Charge your iPhone flat, or simultaneously with your AirPods & Apple Watch in stand mode

Qi2 certified & MagSafe compatible for a fast, safe & efficient charge up to 15W
Built-in official Apple Watch charger to fast charge your Apple Watch Series 9 from 0-80% in around 45 minutes

  Adjust the angle for a hands-free display stand for your iPhone - stream, surf or use StandBy mode


 Compact, space-saving build keeps your space sleek & neat

Weighted metal base enables easy one-hand detachment - just grab & go
Modern, minimalist design complements your desk, coffee table, or nightstand
Know when your devices are charging with discreet LED indicator
Comes with a 6.5ft / 2m USB-C to USB-C cable & a 35W wall charger with international adapters

Discover more magnetic wireless charger options.









2-Year Limited Warranty
14-Day Returns
Secure Checkout
